description: This file contains configuration settings for generating PDFs in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system, including defining paths, page formats, author info, security settings, and loading external default configurations. It sets constants used throughout the PDF generation process.

methods.name: defineFromConfig
methods.description: Defines a constant based on admin configuration settings, falling back to a default if not set.

methods.name: defineFromUserPreference
methods.description: Defines a constant based on the current or focus user preferences, with fallback to default values, and special handling for font name preferences.
